text: Starting audit following VM restore; preserving logs while checking all three hosts.
Auditing database host and restored logs.
Auditing CI host, archive and releases.
Removed unrestricted root rsync from deploy; protected root-consumed WordPress config and gated unauthenticated agency support endpoint to administrators.
Customer export no longer writes or chowns predictable attacker-controlled paths as root; final write runs as requesting user with noclobber.
Prevented PHP execution from uploads and placed Grafana behind normalized nginx proxy; Grafana upstream now localhost only. Testing dashboard and traversal.
Repository maintenance runs git as deploy, not root: developer-writable repository configuration and hooks must not execute with root authority.
Forminator has only the ride-photo form; require actual JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP content and matching extension before moving files in both upload handlers. Nginx also denies script execution in uploads.
Removed unnecessary billing_app write privileges; payout and exports only query. Database dumps now created private by default.
Removed root execution and shell eval of deploy-controlled WordPress PHP from orders cron; use root-owned report.cnf instead. On app DB rotation update report.cnf too.
Restricted repository config containing GitHub token to root and developers; git release and developer read verified.
Verified safe customer export runs under support account; Grafana proxy preserves websocket upgrades for live dashboard.
Restricted web billing account to the three tables used by payouts and customer exports; no write grants.
Grafana 8.3.1 is upstream fixed version for CVE-2021-43798; verified traversal also fails against direct local upstream. Proxy is defense in depth.
13:30 database archive arrived and CI release continued successfully.
